description: This file contains test cases and fixtures for the TalkConfig parsing logic, specifically testing selection provider configuration and timeout values in the context of TalkConfigContract. It defines internal data structures for fixtures, loads fixture data from a JSON file, and includes test functions that verify correctness of TalkConfigParsing methods using these fixtures.

classes.name: TalkConfigContractFixture
classes.description: A Decodable struct that models fixture data for selection and timeout test cases.

classes.name: TalkConfigContractFixtureLoader
classes.description: A static utility enum responsible for loading and locating the fixture JSON data.

classes.name: TalkConfigContractTests
classes.description: A struct containing the actual test functions for selection and timeout fixtures.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and decodes the fixture data JSON file into a TalkConfigContractFixture object.

methods.name: findFixtureURL
methods.description: Recursively searches parent directories to locate the fixture JSON file.
